# rust

Run cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test and cargo doc. Keep Cargo.lock and toolchain pinned.

Source: https://doc.rust-lang.org/
Upstream installation: not verified; select a pinned release before installing.

# node-typescript

Use existing package manager and scripts. Strict types; preserve stack and framework. Run project typecheck and meaningful tests.

Source: https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/
Upstream installation: not verified; select a pinned release before installing.

# generic

Inspect existing conventions. Separate intent, execution, state and evidence. Keep evaluators outside writable worktrees.

Source: https://github.com/TheZehel/illumitech-forge
Upstream installation: not verified; select a pinned release before installing.

# context7

Resolve exact library version and consult primary documentation. Select and pin a reviewed MCP distribution; no automatic install from main.

Source: https://github.com/upstash/context7
Upstream installation: not verified; select a pinned release before installing.
Reviewed source revision: eabe36965ec69b2f3487c4eb329c448dd60b817c. Metadata checked 2026-10-28; execution not yet tested.

# rtk

Opt-in pilot: same fixture with and without output compression; measure output bytes, errors, elapsed time and evidence completeness. Never replace unredacted evidence with summaries.

Source: https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk
Upstream installation: not verified; select a pinned release before installing.
Reviewed source revision: e05c7bdfacfcfe1f845d11f47339e4eae63eb3f5. Metadata checked 2026-10-28; execution not yet tested.

# graphify

Opt-in pilot only. Confirm upstream identity, license and pinned revision before install. Compare navigation quality on a disposable repository; exclude secrets and generated output.

Source: https://github.com/Graphify-Labs/graphify
Upstream installation: not verified; select a pinned release before installing.
Reviewed source revision: 0a8cd4e1e342235fe53e881fb5d591bf0460071f. Metadata checked 2026-10-28; execution not yet tested.

# browser-devtools

Use a pinned browser MCP after reviewing permissions. Verify UI, console and network. Screenshots do not prove backend acceptance.

Source: https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp
Upstream installation: not verified; select a pinned release before installing.
Reviewed source revision: b770c91cb16a37cc5ab93f76efd387cb7f7af6c3. Metadata checked 2026-10-28; execution not yet tested.

# frontend

Preserve design system, semantics, accessibility, keyboard and reduced-motion support. Test actual user flow.

Source: https://react.dev/learn
Upstream installation: not verified; select a pinned release before installing.

# database

Review schema migrations, backups and rollback. Test transactions and recovery; never substitute a live customer database for a fixture.

Source: https://www.sqlite.org/docs.html
Upstream installation: not verified; select a pinned release before installing.

# security

Run pinned dependency/license checks and secret scan. Keep failures visible; no blind allowlists.

Source: https://github.com/EmbarkStudios/cargo-deny
Upstream installation: not verified; select a pinned release before installing.

# ci

Use least-privilege workflow tokens and reviewed action revisions. Separate validation, artifacts and explicit release publication.

Source: https://docs.github.com/actions
Upstream installation: not verified; select a pinned release before installing.

# observability

Emit bounded redacted events with stable run/task IDs. No credentials or raw customer payloads.

Source: https://docs.rs/tracing
Upstream installation: not verified; select a pinned release before installing.

# superpowers

Optional workflow style. Review and pin upstream revision before copying instructions; preserve project rules and user style.

Source: https://github.com/obra/superpowers
Upstream installation: not verified; select a pinned release before installing.
Reviewed source revision: 2ce8aa15d05bd57213e6f746f953aafb7ded7a8b. Metadata checked 2026-10-28; execution not yet tested.

# ponytail

Optional, discovery only. Resolve exact upstream and license with operator before installation. Never execute a mutable remote script.

Source: https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail
Upstream installation: not verified; select a pinned release before installing.
Reviewed source revision: 09c434ab73ca43761c5d8b0c5d341926c2fba710. Metadata checked 2026-10-28; execution not yet tested.

# caveman

Optional, discovery only. Resolve exact upstream and license with operator before installation. Do not impose a communication style.

Source: https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman
Upstream installation: not verified; select a pinned release before installing.
